verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה פָּר֤וֹת הַבָּשָׁן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן הָעֹשְׁק֣וֹת דַּלִּ֔ים הָרֹצְצ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים הָאֹמְרֹ֥ת לַאֲדֹֽנֵיהֶ֖ם הָבִ֥יאָה וְנִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh pā·rō·wṯ hab·bā·šān ’ă·šer bə·har šō·mə·rō·wn hā·‘ō·šə·qō·wṯ dal·lîm hā·rō·ṣə·ṣō·wṯ ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm hā·’ō·mə·rōṯ la·’ă·ḏō·nê·hem hā·ḇî·’āh wə·niš·teh
verses.literal: Hear this word you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy who say to your husbands Bring us more to drink
verses.literalPt: Ouvi esta palavra, vacas de Basã, que estais no monte de Samaria, que oprimis os pobres, que quebrantais os necessitados, que dizeis aos vossos senhores: Dai cá, e bebamos.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ בְּקָדְשׁ֔וֹ כִּ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה יָמִ֖ים בָּאִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְנִשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ בְּצִנּ֔וֹת וְאַחֲרִיתְכֶ֖ן בְּסִיר֥וֹת דּוּגָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: niš·ba‘ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·qā·ḏə·šōw kî hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·niś·śā ’eṯ·ḵem bə·ṣin·nō·wṯ wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯə·ḵen bə·sî·rō·wṯ dū·ḡāh
verses.literal: The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness . . . Behold the days are coming . . . when you will be taken away with hooks and your posterity with fishhooks
verses.literalPt: O Senhor Jeová jurou pela sua santidade que virão sobre vós os dias em que vos levarão com ganchos e as vossas relíquias, com anzóis.

verses.original: וּפְרָצִ֥ים תֵּצֶ֖אנָה אִשָּׁ֣ה נֶגְדָּ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלַכְתֶּ֥נָה הַהַרְמ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·rā·ṣîm tê·ṣe·nāh ’iš·šāh neḡ·dāh wə·hiš·laḵ·te·nāh ha·har·mō·w·nāh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: You will go out through broken walls each one straight ahead of her and you will be cast out toward Harmon declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Saireis pelas brechas, cada qual em frente de si; e sereis lançadas para Harmom, diz Jeová.

verses.original: בֹּ֤אוּ בֵֽית־ אֵל֙ וּפִשְׁע֔וּ הַגִּלְגָּ֖ל הַרְבּ֣וּ לִפְשֹׁ֑עַ וְהָבִ֤יאוּ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ זִבְחֵיכֶ֔ם לִשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bō·’ū ḇêṯ- ’êl ū·p̄iš·‘ū hag·gil·gāl har·bū lip̄·šō·a‘ wə·hā·ḇî·’ū lab·bō·qer ziḇ·ḥê·ḵem liš·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm ma‘·śə·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Go to Bethel and transgress rebel even more at Gilgal Bring your sacrifices every morning your tithes every three days
verses.literalPt: Vinde a Betel e transgredi; a Gilgal e multiplicai transgressões; trazei os vossos sacrifícios todas as manhãs e os vossos dízimos, de três em três dias;

verses.original: וְקַטֵּ֤ר מֵֽחָמֵץ֙ תּוֹדָ֔ה וְקִרְא֥וּ נְדָב֖וֹת הַשְׁמִ֑יעוּ כִּ֣י כֵ֤ן אֲהַבְתֶּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qaṭ·ṭêr mê·ḥā·mêṣ tō·w·ḏāh wə·qir·’ū nə·ḏā·ḇō·wṯ haš·mî·‘ū kî ḵên ’ă·haḇ·tem bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Offer leavened bread as a thank offering and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings For that is what you children of Israel love to do declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: do que é levedado, oferecei um sacrifício de ação de graças, e proclamai ofertas voluntárias, e publicai-as; pois isso é do vosso agrado, ó filhos de Israel, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִי֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָכֶ֜ם נִקְי֤וֹן שִׁנַּ֙יִם֙ בְּכָל־ עָ֣רֵיכֶ֔ם וְחֹ֣סֶר לֶ֔חֶם בְּכֹ֖ל מְקוֹמֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem niq·yō·wn šin·na·yim bə·ḵāl ‘ā·rê·ḵem wə·ḥō·ser le·ḥem bə·ḵōl mə·qō·w·mō·ṯê·ḵem wə·lō- šaḇ·tem ‘ā·ḏay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I afflicted all your cities with cleanness of teeth and all your towns with lack of bread yet you did not return to Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eu também vos dei limpeza de dentes em todas as vossas cidades e falta de pão, em todos os vossos lugares; contudo, não vos tendes voltado para mim, diz Jeová.

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אָנֹכִי֩ מָנַ֨עְתִּי מִכֶּ֜ם אֶת־ הַגֶּ֗שֶׁם בְּע֨וֹד שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ לַקָּצִ֔יר וְהִמְטַרְתִּי֙ עַל־ עִ֣יר אֶחָ֔ת וְעַל־ עִ֥יר אַחַ֖ת לֹ֣א אַמְטִ֑יר חֶלְקָ֤ה אַחַת֙ תִּמָּטֵ֔ר וְחֶלְקָ֛ה אֲשֶֽׁר־ לֹֽא־ תַמְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖יהָ תִּיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’ā·nō·ḵî mā·na‘·tî mik·kem ’eṯ- hag·ge·šem bə·‘ō·wḏ šə·lō·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm laq·qā·ṣîr wə·him·ṭar·tî ‘al- ‘îr ’e·ḥāṯ wə·‘al- ‘îr ’a·ḥaṯ lō ’am·ṭîr ḥel·qāh ’a·ḥaṯ tim·mā·ṭêr wə·ḥel·qāh ’ă·šer- lō- ṯam·ṭîr ‘ā·le·hā tî·ḇāš
verses.literal: I also withheld the rain from you when the harvest was three months away I sent rain on one city but withheld it from . . . another One field received rain another without rain . . . withered
verses.literalPt: Eu também retive de vós a chuva, quando ainda faltavam três meses até a ceifa; fiz que chovesse sobre uma cidade, e que não chovesse sobre outra cidade; um campo recebeu a chuva e o campo que não recebeu a chuva, secou.

verses.original: וְנָע֡וּ שְׁתַּיִם֩ שָׁלֹ֨שׁ עָרִ֜ים אֶל־ עִ֥יר אַחַ֛ת לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֑עוּ וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·‘ū šə·ta·yim šā·lōš ‘ā·rîm ’el- ‘îr ’a·ḥaṯ liš·tō·wṯ ma·yim wə·lō yiś·bā·‘ū wə·lō- šaḇ·tem ‘ā·ḏay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: People staggered from city to city for water to drink but they were not satisfied yet you did not return to Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim, duas ou três cidades andaram errantes a uma cidade para beberem água e não se saciaram; contudo, não vos tendes voltado para mim, diz Jeová.

verses.original: הִכֵּ֣יתִי אֶתְכֶם֮ בַּשִּׁדָּפ֣וֹן וּבַיֵּרָקוֹן֒ הַרְבּ֨וֹת גַּנּוֹתֵיכֶ֧ם וְכַרְמֵיכֶ֛ם וּתְאֵנֵיכֶ֥ם וְזֵיתֵיכֶ֖ם יֹאכַ֣ל הַגָּזָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem baš·šid·dā·p̄ō·wn ū·ḇay·yê·rā·qō·wn har·bō·wṯ gan·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·ḵar·mê·ḵem ū·ṯə·’ê·nê·ḵem wə·zê·ṯê·ḵem yō·ḵal hag·gā·zām wə·lō- šaḇ·tem ‘ā·ḏay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I struck you with blight and mildew in your growing gardens and vineyards the locust devoured your fig and olive trees yet you did not return to Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Feri-vos com mangra e bolor; a multidão das vossas hortas, e das vossas vinhas, e das vossas figueiras, e das vossas oliveiras, comeu-a a lagarta; contudo, não vos tendes voltado para mim, diz Jeová.

verses.original: שִׁלַּ֨חְתִּי בָכֶ֥ם דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם הָרַ֤גְתִּי בַחֶ֙רֶב֙ בַּח֣וּרֵיכֶ֔ם עִ֖ם שְׁבִ֣י סֽוּסֵיכֶ֑ם וָאַעֲלֶ֞ה בְּאֹ֤שׁ מַחֲנֵיכֶם֙ וּֽבְאַפְּכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šil·laḥ·tî ḇā·ḵem de·ḇer bə·ḏe·reḵ miṣ·ra·yim hā·raḡ·tî ḇa·ḥe·reḇ ba·ḥū·rê·ḵem ‘im šə·ḇî sū·sê·ḵem wā·’a·‘ă·leh bə·’ōš ma·ḥă·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·’ap·pə·ḵem wə·lō- šaḇ·tem ‘ā·ḏay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I sent plagues among you like those of Egypt I killed your young men with the sword along with your captured horses I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp yet you did not return to Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Enviei entre vós a peste à maneira do Egito; matei à espada os vossos mancebos e levei os vossos cavalos; fiz chegar aos vossos narizes o mau cheiro do vosso arraial; contudo, não vos tendes voltado para mim, diz Jeová.

verses.original: הָפַ֣כְתִּי בָכֶ֗ם כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ סְדֹ֣ם וְאֶת־ עֲמֹרָ֔ה וַתִּהְי֕וּ כְּא֖וּד מֻצָּ֣ל מִשְׂרֵפָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄aḵ·tî ḇā·ḵem kə·mah·pê·ḵaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- sə·ḏōm wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·mō·rāh wat·tih·yū kə·’ūḏ muṣ·ṣāl miś·rē·p̄å̄h wə·lō- šaḇ·tem ‘ā·ḏay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Some of you I overthrew as I overthrew . . . Sodom and Gomorrah and you were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze yet you did not return to Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Subverti alguns dentre vós, como Deus subverteu a Sodoma e a Gomorra, e ficastes sendo como um tição que se arrebata de um incêndio; contudo, não vos tendes voltado para mim, diz Jeová.

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֵ֚קֶב כִּֽי־ זֹ֣את אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֔ךְ הִכּ֥וֹן לִקְרַאת־ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ‘ê·qeḇ kî- zōṯ ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ hik·kō·wn liq·raṯ- ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore that is what I will do to you O Israel and since . . . I will do this to you prepare to meet your God O Israel
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim te farei, ó Israel; e, porque te farei isso, prepara-te, Israel, a encontrares com teu Deus.

verses.original: כִּ֡י הִנֵּה֩ יוֹצֵ֨ר הָרִ֜ים וּבֹרֵ֣א ר֗וּחַ וּמַגִּ֤יד לְאָדָם֙ מַה־ שֵּׂח֔וֹ עֹשֵׂ֥ה שַׁ֙חַר֙ עֵיפָ֔ה וְדֹרֵ֖ךְ עַל־ בָּ֣מֳתֵי אָ֑רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh yō·w·ṣêr hā·rîm ū·ḇō·rê rū·aḥ ū·mag·gîḏ lə·’ā·ḏām mah- śê·ḥōw ‘ō·śêh ša·ḥar ‘ê·p̄āh wə·ḏō·rêḵ ‘al- bā·mo·ṯê ’ā·reṣ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: For behold He who forms the mountains who creates the wind and reveals His thoughts to man who turns the dawn to darkness and strides on the heights of the earth the LORD the God of Hosts is His name
verses.literalPt: Pois eis quem forma os montes, e cria o vento, e declara ao homem qual seja o seu pensamento; quem faz da manhã trevas e anda sobre os lugares altos da terra; Jeová Deus dos Exércitos é o seu nome.
